page_title: LIL 1-1 BRE | Lille v Brest 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
90+2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Tiago Santos (Lille) inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Pathe Mboup (Brest) commits a foul and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem immediately signals a free kick.
86' Gaetan Perrin (Lille) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
85' Here is a change. Ayyoub Bouaddi is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Tiago Santos (Lille).
83' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brest.
78' Lille couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Gregoire Coudert (Brest) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Tousart (Brest) will replace Junior Dina Ebimbe.
76' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Felix Correia goes off the pitch and Marius Broholm (Lille) comes on.
74' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Olivier Giroud (Lille) replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
71' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Felix Correia feeds Gaetan Perrin (Lille) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
70' Substitution. Pathe Mboup (Brest) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Remy Labeau Lascary walks off.
68' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
67' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Soriba Diaoune and he is replaced by Gaetan Perrin (Lille).
66' Substitution. Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) replaces Ngalayel Mukau.
64' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

62' Fine attempt! Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.

60' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Gregoire Coudert, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

58' 0 - 1 0:1. Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is! Berke Ozer did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Ludovic Ajorque provided the assistance.
57' Close! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
53' Brest keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
51' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

49' Alexsandro (Lille) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
49' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
42' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

38' Benjamin Andre (Lille) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
38' Good work from Lille as they win a corner.
36' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Berke Ozer.
33' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Brest are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
26' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Good team movement sets up Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

23' Lille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
18' Alexsandro (Lille) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
18' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
18' Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Benjamin Andre (Lille) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
15' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' Eric Roy is stunned as referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

10' What a save from Gregoire Coudert! Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.

9' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
6' Some great play by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Gregoire Coudert sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

2' Soriba Diaoune (Lille) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
2' Romain Perraud (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will officiate today.
